title: Base dataset
description: spec/00-overview.md's 'Dataset structure': technology records, layout coordinates, edge geometry, icon atlas references, the compact availabilityMatrix, labelPriority. Shared across all twelve empire profiles -- nothing in this artefact varies per profile. Search index, empire overlays and detail payloads are separate artefacts (their own schema files), fetched independently.

metadata.description: P-10: upstream sources MUST be pinned and recorded, displayed as a 'data as of' marker.

tierBands.description: P-2/S-3/D-13: tier range is unbounded and MUST be enumerated from the dataset at build time, never assumed. A band is a distinct DECLARED tier value actually present among rendered technologies -- never adjusted by graph depth (D-13, spec/decisions.md). Ascending order by declared tier; the last entry is always the Repeatables terminal band.

bandIndex.description: This band's ordinal position (0-based, ascending by declared tier, Repeatables always last). Internal layout geometry only -- never rendered as a number; the band header shows 'tier' (or 'Repeatables').

lanes.description: P-2/P-5: the standard-progression lane plus one per crisis faction, sharing one band axis. All six always present, including a faction at zero population (e.g. Compound -- confirmed real in the current corpus, not a classifier gap; see pipeline/crisis_faction.py) -- a lane is never omitted for being empty.

categories.description: P-4: derived from the dataset at build time, never a hard-coded UI list.

iconAtlases.description: Pointers to packed atlas sheets (pipeline/icons/pack.py). Atlas image bytes are fetched lazily and separately -- see pipeline/icons/resolve.py's Stage 2 note; this array carries references only, matching 00-overview.md's 'icon atlas references' base-dataset item.

png.description: URL/path to the PNG fallback sheet.

tier.description: Declared tier. P-2: unbounded, no fixed upper bound anywhere. D-13: this IS the technology's band -- never adjusted by graph depth or promoted. Its exact pixel position (including horizontal placement within the band's sub-grid) lives in geometry.nodePositions, not as a separate displayed field here.

oneOf.description: The source's own cost field can't be statically resolved to a number -- e.g. a dynamic cost-modifier block (real corpus shape: 10 vanilla 'cosmic storm' technologies declare `cost = { factor = @var inline_script = {...} }` rather than a scalar) -- or the field is absent entirely (5 real cases, all apparently-free starting technologies). Never guessed at or defaulted to 0; a null cost is an honest 'this tool can't state one', not a claim the technology is free.

cost.description: P-12.2/S-1 card field: research cost, first-level/base figure. Per D-4's 'no evaluated weight' precedent, this is a stated field value, not a computed-final number -- in-game costs shift with empire size and other live modifiers the static build can't see, so this is the base/declared cost, approximate by nature, not a promise of what research will actually cost.

crisisFaction.description: P-5: nullable. A technology that is both crisis-sourced and normally researchable is represented once, with this field set, never duplicated as two nodes.

rare.description: P-12.11/S-1: badge, not a warning treatment.

dangerous.description: P-12.3/S-1: warning treatment, outranks rare in outline priority.

oneOf.description: Repeatable. D-13's one declared-tier exception: this technology bands into the terminal Repeatables band (spec/decisions.md's D-13) regardless of its own 'tier' field above, and its card badges repeat count in place of the tier badge -- 'levels' is that count. 'tier' remains resolved, validated and emitted unchanged (still meaningful for internal ordering and the detail popup); it is simply not what the card or band header display for a repeatable node.

Declares no cost_per_level, or it can't be statically resolved. Real corpus: 0/88 rendered repeatables currently hit this -- every repeatable declares a resolvable cost_per_level -- but the field stays nullable rather than assumed always-present.

costPerLevel.description: The per-level cost increment (source's own `cost_per_level` field) -- a SECONDARY card indicator alongside the primary `cost` field above, not a replacement for it. Decision (spec/P-02-layout.md): `cost` (this technology's base/first-level cost, from the top-level `cost` field) is the primary displayed figure; `costPerLevel` is secondary. Rationale: in-game research cost shifts heavily with empire size and other live modifiers, so any absolute number is approximate regardless of which one is shown -- the scaling RATE (`costPerLevel`) is the one thing the card can state truthfully about a repeatable technology's cost trajectory, where the absolute total at level N cannot be. Exact visual treatment (badge text, iconography) is a Stage 3 rendering decision; this field is the semantic data only. Real corpus: exactly the 88-node repeatable set carries this field (0 non-repeatable technologies do -- confirmed, not assumed).

repeatable.description: P-12.2/D-13: boolean-plus-count on the card and in the popup. Full per-level cost progression (the detail popup's fuller breakdown) is a detail-payload field (`repeatableCostProgression`), not here -- `costPerLevel` here is the single scaling-rate number, not the expanded series. Membership is 'source declares a levels field at all' -- both the unbounded (-1) and positive-finite-cap shapes in the corpus are repeatable; sign alone is not the signal (see pipeline.layout.is_repeatable's docstring for the corpus finding behind this).

requiresMods.description: P-16. Empty for the overwhelming majority. A list, not a boolean, so a second dependency costs no schema change.

gates.description: P-3: ordered, primary gate first. Displayed regardless of the selected empire profile -- lives here in the base dataset, not in a per-profile overlay, precisely because it must never vary by profile.

availabilityMatrix.description: P-13's twelve-profile expand-control matrix. Index i is this technology's AvailabilityState for EmpireProfileIndex i (see common.schema.json). Enum values only, no reason text -- the richer per-profile reason string lives in the empire-overlay artefact; this exists so the popup's matrix view doesn't require prefetching all twelve overlays just to render a summary widget.

labelPriority.description: S-3: far-zoom label-decluttering basis. Derived at build time from prerequisite out-degree (how many other technologies depend on this one) plus the rare and dangerous flags -- reproducible, never hand-maintained. Higher survives longer as zoom decreases. Exact derivation formula is Stage 2's to define at implementation time; this field's contract is only that it is build-time-derived and monotonic with 'importance', never authored.

adjacency.description: P-7: forward and reverse adjacency, per edge kind, precomputed -- O(1) lookup per node, never a full edge-set scan at interaction time. Values are indices into the 'edges' array.

forward.description: technology id -> { edge kind -> [edge indices where this technology is "to"] }

reverse.description: technology id -> { edge kind -> [edge indices where this technology is "from"] }
